turns.text: We have a designated staff member that researches each guest.
turns.zh: 我们有个专门的人手，会去调查每一位客人。
是啊，给那些狗娘养的装窃听器。
那滴答滴答的是什么声音？

turns.text: The minute somebody no shows are cancels, we pull somebody up.
turns.zh: 只要有人没来或者取消了，我们就马上补一个人上来。

turns.text: How do they get here that fast?
turns.zh: 他们怎么能来得那么快？
